about: Hand-authored parts of the Designer slot contracts. scripts/slot-contracts.mjs derives every record from src/catalog/slots/<layer>.json and applies these overrides last. purpose replaces the derived purpose (required for every section and frame slot); references (registry/item, resolved against references/manifest.json) replace the manifest-derived references; limits merge over the derived limits. A slot with references here is a hand record and stays authoritative.

sections.band.purpose: Shared section shell every section composes: ground, measure (container width and gutter) and vertical rhythm, and the single source of the section type ramp.

sections.section-header.purpose: Shared section header: optional eyebrow, one heading, optional description and up to two actions, sized by density from the band type ramp.

sections.hero.purpose: Opening band of a marketing page: one heading, an optional eyebrow and description, up to two calls to action and optional media.

sections.features.purpose: Grid of product features, each a heading with an optional description and icon, under an optional section header.

sections.comparison.purpose: Plan or product comparison table: rows of capabilities against columns of offers.

sections.pricing.purpose: Pricing tiers, each with a name, price, feature list and one call to action.

sections.call-to-action.purpose: Closing band that repeats the page's primary and secondary actions under one heading.

sections.form.purpose: Contact-style form band: labelled fields with descriptions and errors, one submit action, and optional error summary, success and anti-spam regions.

limits.references.blocked: @shadcn/form is served empty by the radix-nova registry; @shadcn/field is its successor

sections.legal-prose.purpose: Long-form legal document (privacy, terms): one heading, an optional revision line and a typographic prose body.

sections.steps.purpose: Ordered process steps laid out as one timeline, horizontal where the steps fit side by side and vertical below, each with a heading, optional description and ordinal.

limits.orientation.rule: one timeline whose orientation follows the measure: horizontal from lg, vertical below; never two renderings or a scroll region

frames.site-header.purpose: Marketing site header: brand, primary navigation and header actions, collapsing to a menu on small screens.

frames.site-footer.purpose: Marketing site footer: link columns, legal line and social links.

frames.site-shell.purpose: Marketing page shell: skip link, site header, main landmark, site footer and the toast region.

sections.specimen-swatch.purpose: Studio specimen that renders color tokens as swatches, one per item across the host-supplied axes.

sections.specimen-color-ramp.purpose: Studio specimen that lays color tokens out as ordered ramps so neighbouring steps read side by side.

sections.specimen-type-ladder.purpose: Studio specimen that renders font and type tokens as a ladder of sample lines.

sections.specimen-spacing-ladder.purpose: Studio specimen that renders spacing tokens as a ladder of measured bars.

sections.specimen-radius-ladder.purpose: Studio specimen that renders radius tokens as a ladder of rounded samples.

sections.specimen-motion-player.purpose: Studio specimen that plays motion tokens (animations and durations) with replay controls.

sections.specimen-asset-grid.purpose: Studio specimen that lays brand and media assets out as a grid of labelled tiles.

sections.specimen-icon-grid.purpose: Studio specimen that lays glyph assets out as a grid of icons on their design grid.

sections.specimen-variant-matrix.purpose: Studio specimen that renders a component across its member axes as a matrix of variants.

sections.specimen-section-viewports.purpose: Studio specimen that renders one section at several viewport widths side by side.

sections.specimen-frame-viewports.purpose: Studio specimen that renders one frame at several viewport widths side by side.

sections.specimen-rich-passage.purpose: Studio specimen that renders a rich-text passage with its typographic styles.

sections.specimen-copy-in-context.purpose: Studio specimen that shows Writer copy placed in the section or component that renders it.

sections.specimen-page-viewports.purpose: Studio specimen that renders a whole page at several viewport widths side by side.

sections.pagination.purpose: Pagination control for a list or table: previous and next, page position and total, in pages, load-more or cursor mode.

sections.logo-hero.purpose: Brand band that shows the logo mark large beside the product or company name.

sections.page-header.purpose: Top of an inner page: title, optional eyebrow and description, breadcrumbs, up to two actions and meta label-value pairs.

sections.logo-mark.purpose: Band that shows the brand mark alone on the section ground.

sections.content.purpose: General content band: optional header, a body of paragraphs and lists, optional media, a footnote and an aside of label-value pairs, stacked or split.

sections.article.purpose: Long-form article: header, a typographic body of text blocks and an optional table of contents.

sections.sectioned-document.purpose: Document body made of headed sections (for example a policy or a guide) rendered as one continuous column without its own landmark.

sections.testimonials.purpose: Customer quotes, each with the quote and the attributor's name and role, as a single quote or a grid.

sections.logo-cloud.purpose: Row or grid of customer or partner logos under an optional header, optionally monochrome.

sections.people.purpose: Team or people grid: each person with a name, a role and initials or a photo.

sections.media.purpose: Featured media figure (image, video or chart) in browser, device or bare chrome, with a caption and optional callouts.

sections.gallery.purpose: Image gallery: captioned images in a grid with an optional lightbox.

sections.faq.purpose: Frequently asked questions: question and answer pairs under a section header, as a list or in two columns.

sections.timeline.purpose: Dated events in order, each with a heading, a date and a description.

sections.cards.purpose: Grid of record cards, each with a title, description and meta and an optional image, badge and editorial byline, with loading, empty and error states.

sections.resource-list.purpose: List of records with title, description and meta, plus selection, a search toolbar, pagination and loading, empty and error states.

sections.task-list.purpose: Checklist of tasks, each with a title, description and status (to do, in progress, blocked, done), and the overall progress.

sections.stats.purpose: Key figures: each stat a value and label with an optional description and delta, in a grid or a row.

sections.status-list.purpose: Capability or service status list: grouped items marked available, partial, planned or not offered, with a legend.

sections.usage.purpose: Usage meters: each meter shows use against its limit for a period, with a projection and threshold messages.

sections.account-summary.purpose: Signed-in account summary: identity (name and email), label-value rows and account actions.

sections.data-table.purpose: Data table: columns and rows with sort, selection and grouping, a search and action toolbar, pagination and loading, empty and error states.

sections.data-grid.purpose: Data grid: rows of cells with selection, sort and pinned columns, and loading, empty and error states.

sections.record-detail.purpose: Detail view of one record: labelled fields in groups, a status and up to two actions.

sections.activity-feed.purpose: Feed of activity events, each with an actor, summary, time and field changes, grouped and filterable.

sections.audit-log.purpose: Audit log of entries (time, actor, action, target) with a search filter and export.

sections.newsletter.purpose: Newsletter sign-up band: an email field, a consent line and a submit action with pending, sent and failed messages.

sections.wizard.purpose: Multi-step flow: step list, progress, back and next actions and a final review step.

sections.settings.purpose: Settings form: grouped controls with legends and descriptions, and a save bar that tracks unsaved changes.

sections.column-mapper.purpose: Import column mapper: pairs source columns with target fields and flags the unmapped ones.

sections.access-matrix.purpose: Roles by permissions matrix: grouped permission rows against role columns, with inherited and locked cells and a change summary.

sections.chat.purpose: Conversation thread: message parts (messages, attachments, traces, questionnaires) and a composer.

sections.sign-in-form.purpose: Sign-in form: heading, up to four providers, identifier and password fields, a verification code step, actions and error messages.

sections.link-index.purpose: Index of links, each with a title, description, label and optional badge, as a list, grid or cards.

sections.table-of-contents.purpose: Table of contents for a long page: links to its headings with the active heading tracked.

sections.explorer.purpose: Explorer: a tree of nodes beside a list of items, with the selected item's details.

sections.filter-builder.purpose: Filter builder: rules of field, operator and value, nested in match-all or match-any groups.

sections.empty-state.purpose: Empty state for a region or page (empty, no results, first use): heading, description, illustration and up to two actions.

sections.error-state.purpose: Error state (not found, failure, forbidden, offline): heading, description, error code and retry and report actions.

sections.boundary-message.purpose: Full-page boundary message (sign-in unavailable, not authorized, service unavailable, sign-out confirmation): status, title, description, up to two actions and notes.

sections.notices.purpose: Stack of notices, each with a title, body, optional action and dismiss control.

sections.consent.purpose: Consent band for cookies or tracking: title, body, up to two actions and a policy link.

frames.document.purpose: HTML document frame: head and critical CSS, and a body that hosts the site, app or auth shell, as a page or status document.

frames.app-shell.purpose: Application shell: skip link, sidebar, header, main region, inspector, command palette, page module, state and toast regions, in a standard or immersive layout.

frames.auth-shell.purpose: Authentication shell: skip link and one main region for sign-in and other account flows.

frames.app-header.purpose: Application header: context, breadcrumb trail, actions and info, sticky or static.

frames.app-sidebar.purpose: Application sidebar: header, navigation tree, account and theme controls, docked, collapsed or as an overlay.

frames.inspector.purpose: Inspector panel beside the main region for detail content, docked, collapsed or as an overlay.

frames.sheet.purpose: Sheet dialog that slides in from the start, end or bottom, with a heading, body and footer.

frames.command.purpose: Command palette dialog: search field, grouped commands and an empty state, with an optional keyboard shortcut.
